historical_references.reference: Ashirvan was an ancient Indian sage and the founder of the Ashivara temple at Prabhagarh in Madhya Pradesh. He is believed to have lived in the 1st century AD and is revered for his miraculous powers.

Another reference suggests that Ashirvan was a famous horse belonging to the legendary king Bharata, during the Mahabharata period. The horse was known for its extraordinary strength and speed, and was a significant factor in the great battle of Kurukshetra.
